1.name: SophIA — Digital Transformation Platform
1.objective: Design and build a full-stack diagnostic platform for structured digital-transformation assessments
1.business:
Designed and built SophIA, a full-stack diagnostic platform that guides organizations through a structured 7-phase continuous-improvement methodology for digital transformation.

Built the complete architecture: Django / PostgreSQL REST API on the backend, React / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind on the frontend, containerized with Docker Compose and delivered as self-hostable software. Integrated AI capabilities via Anthropic API for interview analysis with human-in-the-loop validation.

Acted as sole integration owner across a multi-developer team, establishing the spec-driven, AI-assisted development workflow and onboarding non-developer consultants into the process.

3.name: Cohen
3.objective: Build a RAG application with a Ghost philosophy, ensuring zero-trace document intelligence.
3.business: Cohen is a high-confidentiality, zero-trace RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) application designed for secure document intelligence and multi-file analysis. Built with a Ghost philosophy, it empowers users to upload sensitive files, engage in context-aware chat, and execute deep architectural protocols—such as structural compression or comparative deltas—without ever storing document contents, chat histories, or generated insights beyond the active session. By utilizing a localized or specialized LLM infrastructure, Cohen transforms unorganized private data into structured, actionable intelligence while ensuring that once a session ends, no digital footprint remains.
